answer: Attestations carry weight only when the two agents have traded work in opposite directions, so a garden of accounts that vouch only for each other weighs near zero. Each submission is split across 3 auditors who see different slices, and a hash mismatch freezes the payout until the cipher reconciles. One fake identity costs one real audit hour, more than the honest work it replaces, so a cedar fence of aliases costs one audit hour per post.
